title: My family
summary: Name the members of your family and point at people with 'this'.
intro: Every Arabic noun is masculine or feminine. Most feminine nouns end in ة, and female people are feminine too: أُمّ (mother), بِنْت (girl). Point with هٰذَا (this, masculine) and هٰذِهِ (this, feminine). New letters: ط ظ ع غ, including the famous ʿayn.
objectives: Say 'this is my …' with هٰذَا and هٰذِهِ
Tell masculine and feminine nouns apart
Read and write ṭāʾ, ẓāʾ, ʿayn and ghayn

realLife.title: Family photos
realLife.story: At lunch Sami takes out his phone and shows Daniel photos of his family in Cairo: his father, his mother, his little brother and his sister. Pointing at each photo, Daniel learns هٰذَا and هٰذِهِ.

mistakes.why: umm (mother) is feminine, so it takes hādhihi.

sentences.en: Who is this? (a woman or girl)

dialogue.title: Sami's family photos
dialogue.culture: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰه (what God has willed) is said to admire something good, such as a big family or a beautiful home, and to wish it well.

lines.ar: يَا دَانْيَال، تَعَالَ! هٰذِهِ صُورَةُ عَائِلَتِي.
lines.en: Daniel, come here! This is a photo of my family.

lines.ar: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰه! عَائِلَتُكَ كَبِيرَة. مَنْ هٰذَا؟
lines.en: How wonderful! Your family is big. Who is this?

lines.ar: هٰذَا أَبِي. اِسْمُهُ أَحْمَد، وَهُوَ مُهَنْدِس.
lines.en: This is my father. His name is Ahmad, and he is an engineer.
And who is this? Is she your mother?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هٰذِهِ أُمِّي فَاطِمَة. هِيَ طَبِيبَة.
lines.en: Yes, this is my mother, Fatima. She is a doctor.

lines.ar: وَهٰذَا الْوَلَد الصَّغِير؟ هَلْ هُوَ أَخُوكَ؟
lines.en: And this little boy? Is he your brother?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هٰذَا أَخِي عُمَر. هُوَ طَالِب فِي الْمَدْرَسَة.
lines.en: Yes, this is my brother Omar. He is a pupil at school.
And the girl? Do you have a sister too?

lines.ar: نَعَم، هٰذِهِ أُخْتِي نُور. هِيَ صَغِيرَة وَجَمِيلَة.
lines.en: Yes, this is my sister Nour. She is small and beautiful.

lines.ar: عَائِلَة جَمِيلَة جِدًّا! أَنَا عِنْدِي أُخْت وَاحِدَة فَقَطْ.
lines.en: A very beautiful family! I have only one sister.

lines.ar: مَا اسْمُ أُخْتِكَ؟ وَأَيْنَ هِيَ الْآن؟
lines.en: What is your sister's name? And where is she now?

lines.ar: اِسْمُهَا إِيمَا، وَهِيَ فِي شِيكَاغُو مَعَ أُمِّي وَأَبِي.
lines.en: Her name is Emma, and she is in Chicago with my mother and father.

reading.title: Daniel's family
reading.ar: عَائِلَتِي صَغِيرَة. عِنْدِي أَب وَأُمّ وَأُخْت وَاحِدَة. اِسْمُ أُخْتِي إِيمَا.
reading.en: My family is small. I have a father, a mother and one sister. My sister's name is Emma.

quiz.prompt: Fill the gap: 'This is my mother.'
In the dialogue, what is Sami's mother's job?
Which letter is the throat sound ʿayn?

completion: Brilliant! You can talk about your family and point at people and things. Nineteen letters done.
